posts.name: Gita Connects
posts.tagline: See how the Bhagavad Gita’s verses speak to each other
posts.description: A free canvas for studying the Bhagavad Gita as connected verses. All 701 verses, with 1,057 curated links across 10 colour-coded types, each with a strength rating and a one-line reason. Add your own links and notes. No account, no cookies.

posts.name: MileShield
posts.tagline: Mileage and tax tracker built for gig drivers
posts.description: Privacy-first mileage and tax deduction app for rideshare and delivery drivers. Logs continuous working shifts and generates IRS Schedule C exports.

posts.name: Velocity Blocks
posts.tagline: Free time-attack racing game built from road blocks
posts.description: Free time-attack racing game for Android, Windows, iPhone and the browser. 24 tracks, a car, a bike and a truck, nitro, ghosts and a track editor. No ads, no account.

posts.name: MyTrainingDesk
posts.tagline: The intelligent running app - custom plans to race day
posts.description: A training app for runners. Give it your race, its date and your weekly hours: it lays out every week to race day. Sessions are built to your zones and reach your Garmin, COROS, Suunto, Wahoo or Polar via your TrainingPeaks account. Free during early access.

posts.name: Commerce Recovery
posts.tagline: A shared recovery workspace for Shopify chargebacks
posts.description: Sync Shopify Payments chargebacks to a shared app and website workspace. Review orders, evidence and refunds before approving messages, payment requests or stops. The existing Shopify app charges 20% on recovered payments. Recovery is not guaranteed.

posts.name: Live Geometry
posts.tagline: open source interactive geometry website
posts.description: Free and open source interactive geometry: a gallery of drawings, ruler and compass constructions, coordinates, and figures you can drag around.

posts.name: FastTradein
posts.tagline: Trade-in and buyback software for electronics businesses
posts.description: Trade-in and buyback management software for electronics retailers, repair shops and device resellers. Handle website requests, device intake, inspections, revised offers and handover documents. Your business sets prices, buys devices and pays customers.

posts.name: Wobnimo
posts.tagline: Give your AI a face: living 3D mascots in 25 KB
posts.description: 3D on the web, reimagined. Give your app a face people remember. Wobnimo brings real-time 3D characters to any website in ~25 KB: no Three.js, no models to download, nothing to set up. Your users get a companion that thinks while your AI thinks, talks while it streams, and celebrates when the job is done. 10 characters, 10 moods, your brand colours. Free and open source. Spend 10 seconds: copy one prompt, and your agent gives your app its own mascot.

posts.name: Trade Paper
posts.tagline: voice notes to quotes & invoices
posts.description: Voice notes to customer-ready quotes and invoices for tradespeople.

posts.name: ApnaCA
posts.tagline: GST Billing & Invoice
posts.description: ApnaCA is a GST billing and invoice app for small shops and businesses in India. Make GST invoices, track stock, keep your customer khata and see your profit, with an AI assistant you can type to or speak to. Create a bill in a few taps, share it as a PDF on WhatsApp, and know who owes you money at any time. No accounting knowledge needed. Talk to ApnaCA the way you talk to your staff, by typing or by voice.

posts.name: QLineage
posts.tagline: Query Lineage in a Simple Way
posts.description: Paste or upload SQL to visualize CTEs, subqueries, dbt models, sources, joins, and column relationships in an interactive lineage graph.

posts.name: Waver AI
posts.tagline: Voice-first notes with an AI that remembers
posts.description: Waver AI is a voice-first notes app that does far more than take notes. Record, dictate, scan handwriting, talk to an AI that remembers what you said, and turn ideas into images, video and music in one place. Made by Aerosoul Technologies, a new company in Chennai building apps for everyday life.

posts.name: tescast
posts.tagline: Live TV, YouTube and IPTV in your Tesla browser
posts.description: tescast plays live TV, YouTube and your own IPTV list in the Tesla web browser. Video keeps playing for passengers when the car moves. Free-to-air channels from 50+ countries, 12 languages, QR code setup. Free trial in the car, no card.

posts.name: creative-ui
posts.tagline: Designer-made shadcn components and Claude skills
posts.description: creative-ui is an open shadcn registry of React components and Claude skills, built with a designer's eye. Install anything with a single shadcn CLI command, including Classical Collage, a Claude skill for classical painting × modern tech web design. Listed in shadcn's official registry index.

posts.name: Kairo Post
posts.tagline: AI Publishing and Scheduling for X
posts.description: Kairo Post writes, plans, schedules and publishes for your X accounts with an AI agent, in your voice and with your approval. Mentions, DMs and analytics included.
